title: AppleWax
description: This mod adds the ability to create honeycombs for different needs using an apple, a knife, and a campfire or stove.
body:
Description
In this mod, you can create honeycombs with a knife:
![Craft Knife](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d708b4e561aee129803e3d638f2b3801b9caa7d1.png)
![Craft Knife](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5c21b6d8f448069175ea513148d03e0974b4d34.png)
Next, you must collect as many apples as possible.
When you have collected the apples, take a previously crafted knife and carefully remove the wax from the apples:
![Craft Wax](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ecd595e74d5c5599ce2de9bbe2a07ea9fa9b88d.png)
![Craft Wax](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5de2f2450389c6f1e888bf477819b303c2cae51f.png)
Great, now we have wax extracted from the apple peel (don't eat it or you'll lose one point of food). Next, to combine the wax filings (to create honeycombs), we need to process them with fire. To do this, take a campfire (it will be slower) or a stove and coal (it will be faster):
![Craft honeycombs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d32897f141eacf8ed24cd542ec10ce6734da1888.gif)
![Craft honeycombs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b10fcdce148b5ad42fd5f77f9b856a005cb19b7d.gif)
Ready! now you have honeycombs for processing copper or for other needs.
